title: Prefiltered kernel deploy caused accuracy deviation and crash loops - remediation and follow-up
creator: Maya R. Thompson
description: Summary: On 2026-03-01 a production rollout of a kernel selection optimization (internal flag: prefer_prefiltered=true) triggered a correctness regression for several int8-quantized models. Symptoms included: (1) measurable accuracy drift on regression prompt sets (mean ROUGE/EM drop ~0.9–1.6%), (2) elevated crash-loop rates for a subset of serving shards running CUDA driver 12.3 on certain A100/A30 instances, and (3) increased tail latency as the runtime repeatedly retried failing kernels. Impact: several customer inference requests experienced degraded output quality; a small number of dedicated customers observed transient outages while requests were retried. Root cause (summary): two concurrent changes interacted unexpectedly: an aggressive prefiltering kernel selector preferred a new fused-kernel path that assumed a specific dequant scale ordering, while a separate memory-alignment change in the converter produced packed weights with different layout semantics for some models. The fused path did not have a compatibility guard for the packed-weight layout, resulting in incorrect dequant multiplication order for some int8 ops (accuracy drift) and triggering undefined behavior on some GPU/driver combinations (crash loops). Why tests missed it: unit-level quant conversion tests covered canonical layouts and common sequence lengths but did not exercise the cross-product of (packed layout variant, sequence-length > 2048, small-batch end-to-end generation). Canary metrics were focused on latency and error rate but did not include a QoR (quality-of-response) probe derived from ground-truth prompts, so the regression slipped through the canary expansion. The runtime also lacked a fingerprint-based telemetry signal for operator code-paths which would have made the kernel divergence visible earlier.
timeline: 2026-03-01 14:32 UTC: Canary expansion of prefer_prefiltered=true begins (20% -> 60%).
2026-03-01 15:10 UTC: Monitoring alert: uptick in model-specific QoR deviation for quantized-llama-13b-int8 on canary cohort.
2026-03-01 15:22 UTC: Small subset of shards on region-us-west-2 started crash-looping; automated retries increased latency.
2026-03-01 15:45 UTC: On-call rolled back canary to 10% and disabled the kernel selector via runtime feature flag. Immediate crash loops subsided.
2026-03-01 17:00 UTC: Hotfix branch created to add compatibility guard and revert kernel selection logic (PR #5892).
2026-03-02 09:30 UTC: Hotfix deployed to 100% for affected runtime fleet (runtime-1.24.1); QoR and crash metrics returned to baseline but deeper follow-ups required.
root_cause_details: Kernel selector preferred a fused kernel path that assumes dequant scale is applied after a specific reorder; converter produced a packed-weight layout with reversed scale order for some weight groups.
No runtime-level compatibility check was performed to confirm kernel binary supports the precise packed-weight layout variant.

Crash loops were triggered only on GPU/driver combinations that didn't tolerate the undefined memory access pattern produced by the layout mismatch (observed primarily on CUDA 12.3 with driver build 470.xx on A100 / A30).
Canary gates lacked QoR probes; telemetry did not include op-path fingerprints that would have shown a sudden jump in fused-op usage for affected models.
immediate_mitigations: Rollback prefer_prefiltered flag and disable fused kernel path for quantized models via runtime toggle (completed).
Deploy hotfix runtime-1.24.1 that forces kernel fallback to the stable path for flagged models (completed).
Notify impacted customers and provide mitigation guidance for dedicated fleets (support runbook updated).
Scoped investigation of converter output to add a safe-packed-layout marker to converted artifacts (in progress).
long_term_action_items: Add preflight validation to the quant conversion pipeline: emit a compatibility signature that runtime can check at load-time (owner: Lina Chen, due: 2026-03-20).
Instrument operator-level fingerprint telemetry: record 'operator-codepath-id' + model-version for every request to detect sudden distribution shifts (owner: Diego Alvarez, due: 2026-03-18).
Expand canary gating to include QoR probes computed from a fixed prompt set and automated scoring thresholds; require QoR stability before >25% expansion (owner: PM - Arjun Patel, due: 2026-03-25).

Add end-to-end nightly regression suite for quantized models that exercises: packed-layout variants, sequence lengths up to 4096, and small-batch inference across target GPU types (owner: SRE - Priya Kapoor, due: 2026-03-30).

Implement an automated revert policy: if QoR drops >0.5% absolute on any canary prompt set or crash-loop rate >0.5% for >5m, runtime auto-rolls back to previous stable kernel (owner: Runtime SWG, due: 2026-04-05).
Clarify and document supported GPU/driver matrix for each fused kernel and gate kernels behind explicit compatibility metadata from build matrix (owner: Build/Tooling, due: 2026-03-22).

Introduce strict code-review checklist items for kernel merges touching quant paths: require unit coverage for dequant scale ordering and at least one cross-region canary (owner: Eng Docs, due: 2026-03-15).
tests_and_telemetry: Nightly e2e suite coverage expanded to new matrix (int8/int4, packed-layout variants, batch sizes 1-8, seq len 128..4096).
New metric: op_path_fingerprint.unique_count and op_path_fingerprint.top_n by model-version (dashboard created).
QoR probe dashboard with delta and rolling-window alerts (alert threshold initially 0.5% absolute QoR degradation).
Add synthetic unit tests that validate dequant scale ordering invariants during conversion and at runtime load.
communication: Customer-facing status update posted: /status/incidents/2026-03-01-quant-kernel (support ticket batch initiated).
Internal postmortem doc published to Confluence with timeline and action items (link in attachments).
Slack notification and incident channel #inc-quant-kernel active for follow-ups; weekly sync scheduled until all high-priority actions closed.
resolution: Hotfix (runtime-1.24.1) rolled out and prefiler fused path disabled for production quant workloads. Root causes identified; follow-up engineering tasks and telemetry improvements planned and in progress.
next_steps: Complete preflight compatibility signature implementation and runtime guard (priority P0).
Ship op fingerprint telemetry and validate early-detection alerts in staging (priority P0).
Expand nightly quant regression matrix and onboard failing models into canary QoR sets (priority P1).
Re-run canary of prefer_prefiltered with expanded QoR gating once compatibility checks are in place (no earlier than 2026-04-06).

notes: This ticket coordinates cross-team follow-ups (runtime, converter, SRE, PM). The urgency is high due to customer impact and likelihood of similar regressions when new kernels are merged. We will not re-enable the prefiler fused path in production until compatibility signatures, QoR canaries, and op-path telemetry are fully in place and validated.
